project.title: Music studio tools
project.description: 3D models and visual concepts for audio production equipment.
project.longDescription: A comprehensive collection of 3D models designed for audio production environments. This project demonstrates our capability in creating detailed visualizations of complex studio equipment and interfaces.

relatedProjects.title: Everyday T
relatedProjects.description: 3D design and visualization for apparel concepts.
relatedProjects.longDescription: Everyday T represents our exploration into 3D design and visualization for modern apparel. This project showcases detailed modeling, realistic texturing, and conceptual design thinking applied to wearable fashion technology.
